visual.general_description: Two rows of intraoperative photographs and radiographs showing a plate with screws on a femur, then the femur after plate removal.
visual.detailed_description: Two stacked rows, each with four images labelled (A) to (D) at the lower left of each image, so the letters appear twice. In each row, image (A) is a color photograph of an open surgical field with orange or green drapes and printed direction letters P at the top, Cr at the left, Cd at the right and D at the bottom. In the upper row image (A), a gold-colored elongated metal plate with round screw heads, some blue-ringed, lies in the exposed tissue; in the lower row image (A), a dark metal retractor hook holds the tissue open and no plate is visible. In the upper row, images (B) and (C) are grayscale radiographs of a femur with a vertical plate along one side and screws crossing the bone, three near the upper end and three below; image (C) has a white arrowhead near the upper bone region. Upper row image (D) is a grayscale radiograph of the femur without a plate, with a mottled upper bone region. In the lower row, images (B) and (C) are radiographs of a diagonally oriented femur with a plate bearing round holes along its length at the upper end; image (C) has two white arrowheads, one on each side of the bone near the plate. Lower row image (D) is a radiograph of the femur without a plate, with a column of small round dark spots in the upper bone.
